title: Gate then stress before claiming retrieve is done
trigger: when claiming retrieve or health work is complete
behavior_delta: Run npm test then npm run test:stress. Do not claim retrieve or health complete on unit tests alone.
what: Gate is admission, compact retrieve, isolation. Stress is 2k latency, payload vs content, concurrent retrieve, health scale.
why: A 1k needle test can pass while MCP payload, p95, or health still fail.

retrieval_forms.micro: npm test then npm run test:stress.
retrieval_forms.short: Before claiming retrieve or health done: npm test and npm run test:stress.
